cohort: Two groups of patients who underwent caesarean section at referral hospitals in North Kivu, DRC. Group 1 comprised patients from 01/11/2013 to 01/01/2016 (before health staff training). Group 2 comprised patients from June 2019 to January 2020 (after health staff training).
finding: Health staff training was associated with a decrease in neonatal deaths, dystocia, and fetal distress, but an increase in post-operative complications, maternal deaths, scarred uterus, and low birth weight, although the impact on low birth weight and neonatal mortality was not statistically significant.
